SELECT h.created_at AS "created_at!",
  h.author_user_id AS "author_user_id!",
  c.client_name AS "agent_client_name?"
FROM (
    SELECT ph.id,
      ph.created_at,
      ph.author_user_id,
      ph.agent_call_id
    FROM page_history ph
      JOIN pages p ON p.id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.page_id = $1
      AND (
        $2::uuid IS NULL
        OR p.course_id = $2
      )
      AND ph.deleted_at IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id,
      created_at,
      author_user_id,
      agent_call_id
    FROM entity_history
    WHERE entity_id = $1
      AND (
        $2::uuid IS NULL
        OR course_id = $2
      )
  ) h
  LEFT JOIN agent_changeset_calls c ON c.id = h.agent_call_id
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,
  h.id DESC
LIMIT 1
